description: Pre-flight EVM Transaction Simulator, Gas Estimator, Revert Reason Decoder, ERC-20 Allowance Checker & EIP-1967 Proxy Detector ($0.005 USDC). Simulates any transaction via eth_call & eth_estimateGas across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon before signing.

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

spender.description: Optional 0x spender contract address to verify ERC-20 allowance

to.description: 0x target smart contract or recipient address

token.description: Optional 0x ERC-20 token address to verify allowance

tx_hash.description: Optional 0x transaction hash to decode receipt

value.description: Optional native ETH value in wei or 0x hex

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: evm_tx_simulator
